visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Intro phase: A muscular young man with a focused expression sits on the bench of a versatile multi-station gym machine. He is wearing a black sleeveless tank top with a brand logo and white athletic shorts. He sits with his arms crossed over his chest, looking directly at the camera. The background is a clean, modern gym environment with large floor-to-ceiling windows showing an urban street outside with trees and buildings. The lighting is bright and even, coming from both indoor fixtures and natural daylight. (2) Bench Press phase: The man is now lying on his back on the machine's bench. He grips the horizontal padded bar and performs a chest press motion, pushing the bar away from his torso. An anatomical graphic of a human torso with red highlighted chest muscles appears in the lower right corner. The camera is positioned at a medium full shot distance, capturing his full range of motion. (3) Shoulder Press phase: The man sits upright on the machine, facing away from the camera. He grips the upper handles and presses them vertically upwards above his head. His shoulder muscles are clearly defined. An anatomical graphic appears showing highlighted shoulder muscles. The setting remains the same bright gym corner. (4) Lateral Raise phase: The man stands to the side of the machine, holding a cable attachment. He pulls the cable horizontally outwards away from his body, working his lateral deltoids. His posture is upright and stable. The background windows show a clear view of the city street. An anatomical graphic highlights the lateral shoulder muscles. (5) Biceps Curl phase: The man sits on the machine's bench, gripping a lower bar attachment. He performs curls by pulling the bar towards his chest while keeping his elbows tucked. His facial expression shows physical exertion. An anatomical graphic highlights the biceps. The lighting remains consistent and bright. (6) Triceps Press-down phase: Standing facing the machine, he grips a higher attachment and pushes it downwards towards his thighs, focusing on his triceps. The camera angle is slightly from the side to capture the arm extension. An anatomical graphic highlights the triceps muscles. (7) One Arm Row phase: The man stands and bends slightly, pulling a single handle from the machine towards his hip with one hand. His other hand is placed on his waist for stability. An anatomical graphic highlights the back muscles (latissimus dorsi). (8) Bent-over Row phase: Standing and leaning forward with a flat back, he pulls a wider bar attachment towards his abdomen. He is positioned facing away from the window. An anatomical graphic highlights the large muscles of the back. (9) Crunch phase: The man lies back on the inclined part of the machine, gripping handles near his head and performing a seated abdominal crunch motion. His legs are hooked under pads for stability. An anatomical graphic highlights the rectus abdominis. (10) Leg Press phase: He sits with his back against the machine's pad and his feet placed on the large padded roller, pushing it upwards with his legs. His legs are fully extended at the peak of the movement. An anatomical graphic highlights the quadriceps. (11) Leg Curl phase: Lying prone on the machine's bench, he hooks his ankles under the padded bar and curls his legs towards his glutes. The camera captures the movement of his hamstrings. An anatomical graphic highlights the posterior thigh muscles. (12) Seated Calf Raise phase: He sits on the bench with the padded bar resting on his knees, performing calf raises by lifting his heels. He grips the handles on the side for support. An anatomical graphic highlights the calf muscles.
